summary: PDS Biotechnology filed an 8-K (Items 8.01 and 9.01) on October 6, 2026, disclosing a press release announcing a virtual key opinion leader event on October 15, 2026, featuring NCI/CCR investigator Jonathan M. Hernandez, M.D. The event covers Phase 2 PDS0301 clinical outcomes in advanced liver-associated cancers, emphasizing the metastatic colorectal cancer cohort. No transaction terms, pricing, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are stated. This is a routine clinical/communications disclosure, not a special situation; no deal terms and no risk-arb angle. Watch only for clinical data readouts.
